newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner sells reefer fleet for NOK 1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner sells reefer fleet for NOK 1 bln.

text.p: Norwegian shipbuilding and construction group Kvaerner said on Wednesday it had sold its fleet of refrigerated carrier ships for one billion crowns.
The fleet comprises six wholly-owned and two partly-owned vessels and operations.

"The sale of this business...is part of Kvaerner's previously announced disposal programme and provides the group with a profit of approximately 90 million crowns, which will be recorded during the last quarter of the year," a statement from Kvaerner said.
Kvaerner said the fleet had been bought by a new company established by shipping company Agdesidens Rederi AS.
